why_ai: Clients hire a specific leader for consequential calls on undocumented systems; AI erodes the assessment work.
why_clarity: Recommendations are judgement calls the practitioner rarely learns were right.
why_digital: Code and documents read on screens; team interviews and leadership often in person, hired by referral.

why_ai: Scoring past assessments against outcomes is analytics software, not a protected human role.
why_clarity: Outcomes of technical recommendations surface years later, if ever captured.
why_digital: Archived reports and outcome data in, calibration scores out, all digital.

why_ai: Report assembly, formatting and consistency work is exactly what LLM drafting replaces.
why_clarity: Every engagement ends in a similar document checkable against its evidence.
why_digital: Engagement evidence in, reports and decks out, entirely on screens.

why_ai: Scoping, contracts, access, scheduling and invoicing are entirely repeatable admin automation targets.
why_clarity: Each step is a checklist item that is either done or not.
why_digital: Email, templates and scheduling tools, all online.

why_ai: Machine-readable repository, tracker and CI records are ideal inputs for AI analysis directly.
why_clarity: Delivery metrics compute from artefacts and can be checked against interviews.
why_digital: Repositories and delivery data in, analysed findings out, entirely digital.

why_ai: AI decision capture preserves rationale; only the departing author's authority is lost.
why_clarity: Handover packages recur per engagement, but their adequacy shows only months later.
why_digital: Decision records and documents produced and handed over digitally.

why_ai: Rebuild-or-refactor opinions on unfamiliar systems move real money; evidence derivation automates around them.
why_clarity: No agreed method and the advisor rarely learns whether the call was right.
why_digital: Code reading on screens plus interviews with a team met days earlier.

why_ai: Investors need a defensible third-party risk opinion formed against an interested management team.
why_clarity: Diligence follows a recognisable scope per deal, but risks materialise after close.
why_digital: Data rooms and supervised code reads, delivered as reports to investors anywhere.

why_ai: Clients can ask AI to compare named platforms; irreversibility keeps some value in expert judgement.
why_clarity: Recommendations play out over years of operations, rarely judged against alternatives.
why_digital: Vendor material and evidence in, written recommendation out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: The practitioner's depth of understanding across clients is the product; context reload automates, judgement does not.
why_clarity: Four unrelated situations, each judged by feel with little feedback.
why_digital: Work on code and documents, with leadership meetings and referral-based buying.

why_ai: Owning an inherited technical direction requires judgement and institutional presence AI cannot hold.
why_clarity: The half-executed plan is specific to one company and its reasoning is reconstructed, not checked.
why_digital: Code, decisions and documents worked on screens inside the company.
